race.description: Tobin Brothers Celebrating Lives Mdn Plate
race.comment: Open race. Leaning to RAGHNALL (7) who is going okay for a race of this quality. He just found one better when in the market at Moe two back then battled as favourite at Ballarat over 2648m. Placed his only go here and doesn't need to do anything more to be breaking through. CHARLIE MESSY HAIR (3) has been about the mark on the flat, his only win coming over the jumps. His past two at Geelong & Ballarat are good enough to figure here. GREY SABRE (5) has placed his past couple, good at big odds in a stronger maiden at Moe last time out. Up to the longer trip but should give a sight. BLANCHE BASS (8) was okay at Bairnsdale last time in a distant third. Rough hope. CALL ME FRANCIS (2) could sneak a placing.
